data.summary:
Results-driven Senior Network Engineer with 7+ years of progressive experience designing, securing, and optimizing 
enterprise-grade networks across data centers, banking, and government sectors. Deep expertise in routing protocols 
(BGP, OSPF), advanced switching (VLAN, VXLAN), next-generation firewall management (FortiGate, Palo Alto), and 
cloud security (Netskope, Cloudflare). Demonstrated success maintaining 99.9% uptime for mission-critical WANs, 
leading complex network migrations, and delivering scalable, secure infrastructure aligned with business objectives. 
Currently extending cloud and security expertise with AWS, Terraform, and SASE technologies.

all_skills: Cloudflare (CDN, DDoS Mitigation, Zero Trust Access)
AWS (VPC, Transit Gateway, Security Groups, Direct Connect)
Terraform (network provisioning, firewall rule automation, cloud deployments)

responsibilities: Joined as Senior Network Engineer contributing to enterprise network architecture and security strategy.
Leveraging advanced expertise in Palo Alto firewalls, Netskope SASE, Cloudflare, and AWS cloud networking.
Implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform for network automation and deployment pipelines.
Designing and enforcing Zero Trust network access policies across cloud and on-premise environments.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to align network security posture with business and compliance requirements.
Managed network operations and security for enterprise WANs serving 100+ clients, maintaining 99.9% uptime across a high-availability data center environment.
Designed and deployed VLAN/VXLAN configurations enabling seamless server connectivity across 50+ nodes, reducing provisioning time by 30%.
Administered FortiGate and Palo Alto next-generation firewalls; authored and enforced security policies including web filtering, IP filtering, and application control.
Configured and managed IPsec VPN tunnels and SSL VPN gateways for secure remote and site-to-site connectivity for government and private sector clients.
Led network assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities, resulting in measurable improvements to security posture and compliance adherence.
Troubleshot complex Layer 2/3 issues including link failures, packet drops, and link flapping using Wireshark and performance diagnostic tools.
Provided hands-on support for Cisco, Juniper, and Huawei network devices, ensuring optimal performance for data services.
Coordinated with clients and internal teams to resolve critical incidents within SLA, maintaining high client satisfaction.
Served as primary network support contact, diagnosing and resolving LAN/WAN issues and minimizing business-
impacting downtime.
Configured and maintained SSL and IPsec VPN solutions for secure enterprise connectivity across multiple client sites.
Managed Cisco routers and switches, implementing upgrades and proactive maintenance to enhance network reliability.
Implemented structured network change management processes, reducing unplanned outages by improving documentation and runbooks.
Monitored network infrastructure health and performance, proactively identifying and escalating anomalies.
Created and managed JIRA tickets for incident tracking; supported real-time network monitoring and basic remediation tasks.
